programme.title: Lincoln
programme.desc: With the nation embroiled in still another year with the high death count of Civil War, President Abraham Lincoln brings the full measure of his passion, humanity and political skill to what would become his defining legacy: to end the war and permanently abolish slavery through the 13th Amendment. Having great courage, acumen and moral fortitude, Lincoln pushes forward to compel the nation, and those in government who oppose him, to aim toward a greater good for all mankind. (Historical drama, Biography) - 2012

programme.title: The Ox-Bow Incident
programme.desc: In this classic Western, wanderers Gil Carter (Henry Fonda) and Art Croft (Henry Morgan) ride into a small Nevada town plagued by cattle thieves. Initially suspected of being the rustlers themselves, Carter and Croft eventually join a posse out to get the criminals, who also may be involved in a recent shooting. When the posse closes in on a group that could be the fugitives, they must decide on a course of action, with numerous lives hanging in the balance. (Western) - 1943

programme.title: Hombre
programme.desc: John Russell finds that the world is not so welcoming when he returns to his Arizona hometown to collect his inheritance. A white man raised by American Indians, Russell is subjected to numerous instances of racism when people discover his background. When the stagecoach Russell is riding in is held up by a gang run by one of the scheming passengers, Cicero Grimes, it falls to Russell to defend the passengers -- the very people who have dismissed and insulted him. (Western) - 1967

programme.title: Bandolero!
programme.desc: There is little hope for bandit Dee Bishop (Dean Martin) and his gang as they wait to be hanged. But at the last second, the hangman -- Dee's brother, Mace (James Stewart), in disguise -- helps them escape. After kidnapping a rancher's wife (Raquel Welch) and with the vengeful sheriff (George Kennedy) in pursuit, they retreat to an abandoned town. Tired of their desperado life, the brothers consider going straight. But when a gang of bandoleros attacks, their chances at starting over seem dim. (Western, Drama) - 1968

programme.title: 100 Rifles
programme.desc: When half-breed Indian Yaqui Joe (Burt Reynolds) robs an Arizona bank, he is pursued by dogged lawman Lyedecker (Jim Brown). Fleeing to Mexico, Joe is imprisoned by General Verdugo (Fernando Lamas), who is waging a war against the Yaqui Indians. When Lyedecker attempts to intervene, he is thrown into prison as well. Working together, the two escape and take refuge in the hills, where Lyedecker meets beautiful Yaqui freedom fighter Sarita (Raquel Welch) and begins to question his allegiances. (Western) - 1969

programme.title: Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: A celebration of love and creative inspiration takes place in the infamous, gaudy and glamorous Parisian nightclub, at the cusp of the 20th century. A young poet (Ewan McGregor), who is plunged into the heady world of Moulin Rouge, begins a passionate affair with the club's most notorious and beautiful star (Nicole Kidman). (Musical, Drama, Romance) - 2001

programme.title: Arachnophobia
programme.desc: After a nature photographer (Mark L. Taylor) dies on assignment in Venezuela, a poisonous spider hitches a ride in his coffin to his hometown in rural California, where arachnophobe Dr. Ross Jennings (Jeff Daniels) has just moved in with his wife, Molly (Harley Jane Kozak), and young son. As town residents start turning up dead, Jennings begins to suspect spiders, and must face his fears as he and no-nonsense exterminator Delbert McClintock (John Goodman) fight to stop a deadly infestation. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1990

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: After the members of a team of scientists (Harold Ramis, Dan Aykroyd, Bill Murray) lose their cushy positions at a university in New York City, they decide to become "ghostbusters" to wage a high-tech battle with the supernatural for money. They stumble upon a gateway to another dimension, a doorway that will release evil upon the city. The Ghostbusters must now save New York from complete destruction. (Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure) - 1984

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: After saving New York City from a ghost attack, the Ghostbusters -- a team of spirit exterminators -- is disbanded for demolishing parts of the city during the battle. But when Ghostbuster Peter Venkman learns that spirits have taken an interest in his son, the men launch a rogue ghost-chasing mission. The quest quickly goes awry, landing them in court. But when the ghosts turn on the judge, he issues an order allowing the Ghostbusters to get back to work. (Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure) - 1989

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Paranormal researcher Abby Yates and physicist Erin Gilbert are trying to prove that ghosts exist in modern society. When strange apparitions appear in Manhattan, Gilbert and Yates turn to engineer Jillian Holtzmann for help. Also joining the team is Patty Tolan, a lifelong New Yorker who knows the city inside and out. Armed with proton packs and plenty of attitude, the four women prepare for an epic battle as more than 1,000 mischievous ghouls descend on Times Square. (Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure, Action) - 2016

programme.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
programme.desc: Evil Judge Turpin (Alan Rickman) lusts for the beautiful wife of a London barber (Johnny Depp) and transports him to Australia for a crime he did not commit. Returning after 15 years and calling himself Sweeney Todd, the now-mad man vows revenge, applying his razor to unlucky customers and shuttling the bodies down to Mrs. Lovett (Helena Bonham Carter), who uses them in her meat-pie shop. Though many fall to his blade, he will not be satisfied until he slits Turpin's throat. (Musical, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2007

programme.desc: Noah heads to Vancouver to sample Canadian Poutine Stuffed Burger, Jerk Chicken Dumplings, and the Donuccino; Noah visits the Fryeburg Fair in Maine, where he tries the Pig Pile in Paradise and eats local favorites like a Lobster Roll.

programme.title: Carnival Eats - Piefidelity
programme.desc: Delaware State Fair; shrimp dog; "Crabtastic Po' Boy"; Apple Scrapple burger; deep-fried Key lime pie.

programme.title: Ready for a safer shower? Enjoy a one-day bath remodel with Jacuzzi.
programme.desc: Trusted brand Jacuzzi Bath Remodel and interior designer Christina Hall share their secrets on how you can easily and affordably transform your bathroom into a gorgeous custom, safe, stylish space in 1 day! Call for a FREE quote & installation.

programme.title: Freedom to Leave the House! Inogen Portable Oxygen
programme.desc: Regain independence and enjoy greater mobility with the compact design and long-lasting battery of portable oxygen.

programme.title: Tournament of Champions - If You Can't Take the Heat...
programme.desc: Guy Fieri continues the Tournament of Champions VI first-round battles with four more intense one-on-one sudden death matches; in the final battle of the night, four-time finalist Jet Tila takes on qualifier winner Pyet DeSpain.

programme.title: Halloween Baking Championship - Who's Ruining Your Ruin?
programme.desc: John Henson asks the bakers to create a dessert that resembles an assigned classic ruin and represent the monster who haunts it; judges Stephanie Boswell, Aarti Sequeira and Zac Young pick the winner to receive $1,000, and one baker goes home.

programme.title: Halloween Baking Championship - Doll Trouble
programme.desc: Henson challenges the remaining six bakers to face off in head-to-head matchups to create demon doll desserts, either Paris-Brest, baked cheesecake or Swiss roll; the winner of each matchup is safe, and the overall challenge winner receives $1,000.

programme.title: Halloween Wars - Back from the Dead: Nightmare Pet Shop
programme.desc: Monstrous pets take over as Jonathan Bennett challenges the teams to create haunted pet shop showpieces and pumpkin-infused desserts; a surprise carving battle puts the teams to the test before judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller make their decision.

programme.title: Sweet Deceit - Trick or Treat: Haunted Manor
programme.desc: Host Josh Peck sends Halloween superfans Alyssa, Harry and Justice into a historic haunted manor where master baker Andrew Fuller has hidden six scarily lifelike sweets. Can they find them all and win $12,000?

programme.title: Sweet Deceit - Trick or Treat: Escape Room of Doom
programme.desc: Host Josh Peck is locked in with three escape room enthusiasts who search in four spooky rooms for six secret sweets hidden by master baker JonnyCakes; they must find them all to get out, and win $12,000!

programme.title: Sweet Deceit - Trick or Treat: Horror Story House
programme.desc: Host Josh Peck welcomes a team of ghost hunters into one of America's most famous haunted houses where baker Ashley Holt has hidden six secret sweets; if the trio of paranormal experts can divine them all, they'll win $12,000.

programme.title: Sweet Deceit - Trick or Treat: Movie Set Morgue
programme.desc: Host Josh Peck welcomes three horror movie buffs to a haunted hospital movie set to find six secret sweets hidden by master baker JonnyCakes among Hollywood props and behind-the-scenes movie gear; can they dissect the truth and win $12,000?

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Breakfast, Brisket and Belly
programme.desc: In Los Angeles, a late-night spot serves breakfast with a twist, like drunken French toast; in Columbus, Ohio, a funky joint serves creative combos like brisket on corn cakes; in Phoenix, a barbecue stop smokes up prime rib and pork belly dumplings.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Seafood and Savory
programme.desc: A Lansing, Mich., food truck dishes out shrimp burgers and a unique potato popper; a Bosnian restaurant in Tucson, Ariz., fires up legit Eastern European specialties; a down-home Southern seafood spot cooks up clam chowder and fries up favorites.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Tasty Traditions
programme.desc: In Seattle, a funky spot makes their name with scratch-made Russian piroshki; a joint in Kona serves up a bite of culture with their authentic Hawaiian cuisine; in Chicago, an old-school Jewish deli dishes out their specialties cafeteria-style.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Sandwich Showcase
programme.desc: Guy Fieri is on the road to grab some serious sandwiches; in Austin, a rock-n-roll brunch bar adds a funky touch to meatloaf and a Monte Cristo; a Texas joint puts some '90s hip-hop into its stacked-up specialties.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Coming Together in Cali
programme.desc: Guy visits Chico, Calif., celebrating the town's food scene as residents recover from ravaging fires; a wood-fired Italian spot cooks up pork ragù; a bakery serves up savory specialties like black bean chili; a pub serves a "Pho-rench Dip."

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Eating Alaska
programme.desc: Guy Fieri and his son, Hunter, are taking a culinary journey up to Juneau, Alaska, and they dive into everything from a family-run, wood-fired pizza wagon making reindeer pie to a funky basement spot mashing up Latin-Asian fusion.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Family Meals
programme.desc: Two brothers-in-law carry on a decades-long seafood tradition; a mother-son duo running a breakfast, lunch and dinner joint in honor of their Pop; father-son meat masters firing up killer char-becue.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Lots of Latin
programme.desc: Guy Fieri is loading up on all kinds of Latin on this trip; in Logan, Utah, a Salvadoran spot puttin' out pupusas and a cabeza creation.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - From Authentic to Inventive
programme.desc: Dishes from real deal to really creative; in Portland, Ore., a 70-year-old icon is serving up authentic Chinese recipes from the chef's hometown; a restaurant in Oklahoma City is cooking chicken and biscuits.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Meat and Heat
programme.desc: Guy Fieri rolls into a tucked-away panini paradise in Chehalis, Wash.; a Korean spot in Brentwood, Tenn., gets spicy with its chicken and bulgogi; in Houston, a barbecue joint throws Tex-Mex into the mix with brisket tacos and jalapeño sausage.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - From Appetizers to Dessert
programme.desc: In Laramie, Wyo., an old-school café has green chili burritos and pie; a spot in Anchorage, Alaska has blackened chicken gnocchi.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Thai, Pie and Fries
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's diving into Thai food, pie and hearty fries; in San Diego, a spot is serving fish and ribs; in Arroyo Seco, N.M., a New Zealand food truck makes meat pies; a cozy joint loads up bison chili fries.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: With roadside diners, vintage drive-ins and out-of-the-way "dives" enjoying a resurgence of hipness among foodies, host Guy Fieri travels across America in search of some of the best "greasy spoon" eateries. The restaurants that Guy visits are usually well-known among locals and other people in the region. While at each location, Fieri talks to the staff as well as the customers to get their thoughts on the food. Many episodes feature eateries that are connected by a common thread, such as burgers or comfort foods. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2007-04-23

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

programme.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
programme.desc: Obsessed with cars since childhood, inventor Preston Tucker (Jeff Bridges) has his first successful auto design partnership in the 1930s and designs a successful gun turret for World War II use. With those achievements under his belt, Tucker is determined to create a futuristic car for the masses: the Tucker Torpedo. However, his dreams are challenged by Detroit's auto manufacturers, production problems and accusations of stock fraud, and he is forced to defend his dream and honesty in court. (Biography, Historical drama) - 1988

programme.title: In Old Caliente
programme.desc: In California, Roy (Roy Rogers) works on the large ranch of Don Jose (Frank Puglia), one of the last of the major Spanish landowners. The foreman of the ranch, Saguaro (Jack LaRue), is involved with a gang of bandits and hopes to pit the newly arriving Americans against the dwindling Spanish and native populations. Saguaro becomes Roy's nemesis, getting him banished from the ranch and framing him for various crimes, but Roy concocts an audacious plan to clear his name. (Western) - 1939

programme.title: Outlaws of the Plains
programme.desc: An impressionable cowpoke, Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), hears a voice claiming to be that of an old Native American, telling him the location of some hidden gold. Fuzzy does find gold, but the land has already been claimed by Nord Finner (Charles King Jr.). Finner offers to sell his claim, and Fuzzy is eager to buy. Then Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe), a friend of Fuzzy's, shows up and discovers that a gang of outlaws is behind a scheme to rob everyone in the area. (Western) - 1946

programme.title: The Carson City Kid
programme.desc: The Carson City Kid (Roy Rogers) stops stagecoaches traveling between Wild West mining towns, searching their mail sacks for letters addressed to Morgan Reynolds, the man who killed his brother. Discovering that Reynolds operates a saloon under the name Lee Jessup (Bob Steele), the Kid takes a job as the saloon's bouncer. While vying with Reynolds for the affections of singer Joby Madison (Pauline Moore), the Kid discovers a swindled miner (Noah Beery Jr.) who claims to be the Carson City Kid. (Western) - 1940

programme.title: Romance of the West
programme.desc: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), along with his sidekick, Ezra (Emmett Lynn), oversees the peaceful coexistence of the Native American tribes with the white settlers of Antelope Valley. The treaty that binds the two groups is threatened when some of the town leaders learn that the Native American land contains rich deposits of silver. Eager to oust the tribes and claim the silver, the town leaders try to provoke an attack that would break the treaty. It's up to Eddie to stop them in time. (Western) - 1946

programme.title: Lights of Old Santa Fe
programme.desc: In this musical western, Marjorie Brooks (Dale Evans) is the owner and operator of a rodeo that's an antiquated touring company on its last legs. Her business rival, Frank Madden (Richard Powers), offers to combine their operations if the lovely Marjorie will be his bride. Though she initially rebuffs his proposal, a canceled booking tips the scales and forces Marjorie to accept. But rodeo rider Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) suspects Frank is behind Marjorie's troubles and sets out to investigate. (Western) - 1944

programme.title: The Dawn Rider
programme.desc: John Mason (John Wayne) suffers a cruel homecoming when he witnesses his father's murder as he rides into town. Incensed, he chases after the killers, but he suffers a gunshot wound that cuts his pursuit short. Alice Gordon (Marion Burns) sees to his injury, and Mason is taken by her kindness and beauty. But things turn sour when her beau, Ben (Reed Howes), becomes jealous. After Mason discovers the men who killed his father, his plan for a duel is sabotaged by Ben, who has been manipulated. (Western) - 1935

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
programme.desc: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing. (Western) - 1941

programme.title: The Desert Trail
programme.desc: John Scott (John Wayne) is a rodeo rider, assisted by his buddy Kansas Charlie (Eddy Chandler). But while the duo is settling a debt with their promoter, Farnsworth (Henry Hall), thieves Pete (Al Ferguson) and Jim (Paul Fix) murder and rob Farnsworth and manage to pin the crimes on John and Charlie. The accused then flee, assume two new identities, take up with a shopkeeper named Anne (Mary Kornman) and set out to clear their names and bring the real killers to justice. (Western) - 1935

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Senorita
programme.desc: Things go from bad to worse for singing cowboy Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and his trusty companion, Teddy Bear (Guinn "Big Boy" Williams), when, after losing their jobs at a local café, the pair are accused of having kidnapped young Chip Williams (Mary Lee) who, in reality, is merely a runaway who's been tagging along with the cowpokes. But amidst these problems, Roy and his partner decide to team up with the girl and her half-sister, Ysobel (Dale Evans), and search for some long-buried treasure. (Western) - 1944

programme.title: The Man From Utah
programme.desc: One day, John Weston (John Wayne) helps stop a bank robbery. George Higgins (George Hayes), the town's grateful marshal, asks Weston for his help in solving another crime. It seems someone at a touring rodeo show is killing the top riders before they can take home the trophy -- and the prize money. Weston agrees to investigate and works his way into the show, which is run by the shady Spike Barton (Edward Peil). As Weston gets closer to the truth, he finds himself in even greater danger. (Western) - 1934

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom. (Western) - 1948

programme.title: From Monet to Van Gogh: A History of Impressionism - Baudelaire and the Definition of Modernism
programme.desc: A poet and art critic named Charles Baudelaire begins writing systematically about art in 1846; his basic idea is that art should be "of its own times"; he struggles to find artists who will embody his ideals.

programme.title: From Monet to Van Gogh: A History of Impressionism - The Shock of the New
programme.desc: Edouard Manet is among the best-educated and most authoritatively independent artists of the 19th century; he paints works that transcend Baudelaire; Manet's painting is as great as Baudelaire's poetry and greater than his art criticism.

programme.title: Cooking Across the Ages - Understanding Culture through Cooking
programme.desc: What one can learn about different cultural groups through the lens of their cookbooks; looking at two chicken recipes 200 years and a continent apart; learning to cook dishes from a 1748 French cookbook and "The Can-Opener Cookbook" of 1953.

programme.title: Cooking Across the Ages - Ancient Rome: Cooking with Apicius
programme.desc: Whether the recipes in "De re coquinaria" are bizarre and disgusting, or they reflect a time of elegance and luxury; exploring its sala cattabia, minutal of apricots and botellum; finding three delicious, and even somewhat familiar, dishes.

programme.title: Cooking Across the Ages - Imperial China: Soybeans and Dumplings
programme.desc: Examining the Chinese Wei dynasty's "Qi Min Yao Shu"; learning about Chinese agricultural practices going back to antiquity; the fermentation practices of the time; following a scaled-down recipe to create a fermented black bean dish.

programme.title: Cooking Across the Ages - Medieval Egypt: Chickpeas and Phyllo Dough
programme.desc: Exploring recipes from 14th-century Egypt that reflect the interchange between the many cultures of the Eastern Mediterranean of the time; learning to make himmas kassa and a light and flaky phyllo dough stretched to the size of a table.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites - The Origins of Modern Archaeology
programme.desc: What archeologists actually do; the nature and scope of their work; misconceptions about the field; tracing the history of archeology, from its beginnings with the ancient Babylonian king Nabonidus to archeological luminaries of the 20th century.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites - Excavating Pompeii and Herculaneum
programme.desc: Traveling to the sites of Pompeii and Herculaneum, which are destroyed by the 79 A.D. eruption of Mount Vesuvius; the history of their excavation; the preservation of buildings, objects and human remains; discovering details of ancient Roman life.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites - Schliemann and His Successors at Troy
programme.desc: Following the exploits of Heinrich Schliemann as he looks for Homer's Troy; learning about his dig through nine stratified cities; the finds; the debates over which city is Troy; tracing subsequent work at the site; examining the conclusions.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites - Early Archaeology in Mesopotamia
programme.desc: The history of finds in Mesopotamia; the 19th-century unearthing of the Assyrian palaces at Nimrud and Nineveh, with their libraries of cuneiform texts; contemplating the 20th-century discovery of the treasures of the "Death Pits of Ur".

programme.title: Notorious London: A City Tour - Oscar Wilde's Decadent London
programme.desc: London when it is home to Oscar Wilde at the close of the 19th century; the details of Wilde's trial for indecency; the way London society is structured; how immense wealth and privilege, for some, leaves its imprint on the city and its history.

programme.title: Notorious London: A City Tour - St. Paul's Cathedral in Faith, Fire, and Sin
programme.desc: St. Paul's Cathedral has overlooked London from a high point in the city for generations; the history of this church that has been much more than a place of worship; it has survived fire and the ravages of war; episodes from the cathedral's past.

programme.title: Notorious London: A City Tour - Getting Blitzed at London's Café de Paris
programme.desc: An evening in March 1941, when the Café de Paris is destroyed in the Blitz; the history of the café; how its destruction reflects the horrors of wartime London; the resiliency of the citizens who keep calm and carry on under the threat of war.

programme.title: Notorious London: A City Tour - On Carnaby Street during the Swinging '60s
programme.desc: Carnaby Street emerges in the 17th century; a symbol of social change in the 1960s; its history; it becomes a magnet for trendsetters and youth culture in post-war London; why these changes are embraced by some and seen as a threat by others.

programme.title: In the Footsteps of Van Gogh - The World of Vincent Van Gogh
programme.desc: Tying together several facts about Van Gogh's life.

programme.title: From Monet to Van Gogh: A History of Impressionism - Napoleon III's Paris
programme.desc: Napoleon III declares himself emperor of France in 1853; his aim is to modernize the economy of France, create a sophisticated rail-transport system and completely rebuild Paris; this means that, for most Parisians, life is utterly disrupted.

programme.title: From Monet to Van Gogh: A History of Impressionism - Baudelaire and the Definition of Modernism
programme.desc: A poet and art critic named Charles Baudelaire begins writing systematically about art in 1846; his basic idea is that art should be "of its own times"; he struggles to find artists who will embody his ideals.

programme.title: From Monet to Van Gogh: A History of Impressionism - The Shock of the New
programme.desc: Edouard Manet is among the best-educated and most authoritatively independent artists of the 19th century; he paints works that transcend Baudelaire; Manet's painting is as great as Baudelaire's poetry and greater than his art criticism.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas - Three Peoples Collide
programme.desc: Neither the Eurocentric term 'discovery' nor the blandly neutral 'encounters' do justice to the impact of Europeans, Africans and Native Americans coming together in the New World; a collision whose causes and effects are outlined in this lecture.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas - The Native Americans
programme.desc: Most of the inhabitants of the Americas arrive in migratory waves from Asia between 40,000 and 2,000 B.C.; their civilizations are based on sophisticated irrigation and farming; complex religions and social structures; rivaling those of Europe.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Experiencing Medieval Europe - The Medieval City - A Feast for the Senses
programme.desc: The sights and smells of the medieval city; exploring the rich details of markets, monasteries, churches and religious and civic events; life in the townhouses of the rich, the tenements of the poor; the activities of medieval societies.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Experiencing Medieval Europe - Rothenburg - Jewel On the Romantic Road
programme.desc: A well-preserved German medieval city; exploring the imposing mansions of the city's former elite, the grand fountains and the market square with its remarkable gothic town Hall; visiting St. Jakob's Church; walking the bastions of the city walls.

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America - Native America: A Story of Survival
programme.desc: The commonly held views of Native Americans and the realities of a tapestry of vibrant cultures; Cobb explains the pitfalls that occur when history does not provide this crucial viewpoint; the mistake of consigning Native Americans to the past.

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America - The Columbian Exchange: New Worlds for All
programme.desc: The misleading dichotomy of Old World and New World impacts perceptions of Native Americans; the Columbian Exchange is the crux behind the creation of new worlds for all; shaping everything from the fauna and flora to the cuisines of the world.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C. - How Washington DC Came to Be
programme.desc: Uncovering the origins of the District of Columbia; how the location for the national government is chosen; the original design and vision for the city by artist and engineer Pierre Charles L'Enfant; the creation and history of the National Mall.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C. - The White House and the Presidency
programme.desc: Tracking the history and fortunes of the White House; visiting the White House, beginning with the Oval Office and Cabinet Room; visiting the parks adjoining the White House; the Jefferson and Franklin Delano Roosevelt memorials.

programme.title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History - Star-Spangled Banner - Inspiring the Anthem
programme.desc: A tour of national treasures from the Smithsonian; the artifact that inspires the national anthem; the flag that flows over Fort McHenry when Francis Scott Key pens "The Star-Spangled Banner"; the battle for the fort and the history of the flag.

programme.title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History - Presidents and Generals - Images of Leadership
programme.desc: How some of the country's greatest leaders have seen themselves and been seen by the nation; Washington's uniform, swords and portraits; notable photographs of Lincoln; the history of Eisenhower's distinctive army jacket and his presidential look.

programme.title: Cooking Across the Ages - Understanding Culture through Cooking
programme.desc: What one can learn about different cultural groups through the lens of their cookbooks; looking at two chicken recipes 200 years and a continent apart; learning to cook dishes from a 1748 French cookbook and "The Can-Opener Cookbook" of 1953.

programme.title: Cooking Across the Ages - Ancient Rome: Cooking with Apicius
programme.desc: Whether the recipes in "De re coquinaria" are bizarre and disgusting, or they reflect a time of elegance and luxury; exploring its sala cattabia, minutal of apricots and botellum; finding three delicious, and even somewhat familiar, dishes.

programme.title: True History
programme.desc: (Special, Documentary) - 2022-01-01

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang
programme.desc: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An
programme.desc: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
programme.desc: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Savoury Vietnamese Pancakes in Huė
programme.desc: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
programme.desc: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
programme.desc: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Delicious Bun Cha in Hanoi
programme.desc: Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Sipping Gin in Sapa
programme.desc: Nearing the end of his Vietnamese journey, Luke stops in Sapa, a hilltop region that he remembers from his travels fifteen years ago. Join Luke as he rekindles a friendship from his previous visit and learns about a local dish of dried buffalo.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Secret Family Recipies in Ho Chi Minh
programme.desc: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Vietnamese Pizza in Dalat
programme.desc: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
programme.desc: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
programme.desc: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
programme.desc: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Making Couscous in Tunisia
programme.desc: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Bread Masters
programme.desc: Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Magic of Piloncillo
programme.desc: The Garza family invites Pati to their vineyard to help the community make piloncillo - and it's hard work! Then, in the magic town of Bustamante, three sisters make traditional bread in adobe ovens.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Tacos and a Tostada
programme.desc: Pati celebrates everyone's favorite Mexican creation, the taco. In her kitchen, Pati creates a pair of Jalisco-inspired tacos and a Ceviche tostada that are sure to satisfy any true taco-lover.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Texas BBQ in the Orange Belt
programme.desc: Pati visits BBQ champion Luis Rivas to taste his Mexican take on Texas-style BBQ, and he hosts a traditional carne asada at his family's orange grove. Then Pati learns how Glorias candies are made.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Go Greek! Clash of the Titans
programme.desc: The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated and is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birthplace of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Highland Fling
programme.desc: The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Three Amigos
programme.desc: On a mission to taste the world's best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA border into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Brokeback Mountain
programme.desc: After four weeks on the road, Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lover's paradise, and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - What Happens in Vegas
programme.desc: Gordon wants to show Fred & Gino that the food and fresh produce are off the charts! In Las Vegas they indulge in one of the most expensive beef burgers. After a night at the casino they're on the road again to experience the real wild west. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - San Fran Summer of Love
programme.desc: Gino & Fred are excited to head to San Francisco for their very own Summer of Love. Gordon tries to embrace the flower power mood, but he's more interested in the 61 Michelin Stars. The boys travel to a Napa Valley vineyard in a hot air balloon. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.desc: The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated and is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birthplace of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Schostakowitsch - Präludien und Fugen
programme.desc: Die 24 Präludien und Fugen, op. 87 von Dmitri Schostakowitsch dienten als Inspiration für dieses Projekt von Simona Bucci. Sieben Tänzer der „Compagnia Simona Bucci" treten zu den Präludien und Fugen Nr. 1, 5, 7, 12, 13, 14, 16 und 24 auf.

programme.title: Fantasymphony - Ein Konzert voller Feuer und Magie
programme.desc: Der Publikumshit Fantasymphony ist zurück. Diesmal gibt es epische Musik aus den größten Fantasy-Filmen, -Serien und -Spielen. Das Dänische Nationale Symphonie-Orchester öffnet die Tore zu den magischen Welten aus der Herr der Ringe und mehr.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Der Karneval der Tiere
programme.desc: Der mexikanische Dirigent Carlos Miguel Prieto leitet die Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in einer Aufführung der Suite "Der Karneval der Tiere" von Camille Saint-Saëns. Sie besteht aus 14 Sätzen, von denen jeder ein anderes Tier darstellt.

programme.title: Sheherezade
programme.desc: Diese Version von "Sheherezade" von Jean-Christophe Maillot ist ein Tribut an die Ballets Russes und spiegelt die Vereinigung von Choreographie und fiktiven sowie realen Charakteren wider, die seine künstlerische Welt angetrieben hat.

programme.title: Beethoven - Streichquartette Nr. 4, 5 und 12
programme.desc: Das französische Streichquartett Quatuor Ébène feierte Beethovens 250. Geburtstag mit der Aufnahme all seiner sechzehn Streichquartette. Im Herbst 2020 präsentierte das Ensemble das gesamte Meisterwerk in sechs Konzerten in der Philharmonie de Paris.

programme.title: House of Dreams
programme.desc: Ein fantasievolles Konzert führt mit barocker Musik auf eine magische, musikalische Reise. Das Ensemble des Tafelmusik Barock Orchester hat sich auf historische Performances spezialisiert. Ihre Musik trifft auf barocke Kunst.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C-Dur, Op. 17
programme.desc: Nachdem er alle 32 Beethoven Klaviersonaten aufgenommen hat, um den 250. Geburtstag des Komponisten zu feiern, entschied sich der gefeierte italienische Pianist Riccardo Schwarz dazu, Soloklavierwerke von Robert Schumann aufzunehmen.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Philippe Jordan dirigiert das Orchester de l'Opéra national de Paris in Beethovens Symphonie Nr. 8. Gespielt wird die Symphonie in F-Dur Op. 93, welche in den Jahren 1812 und 1813 geschrieben wurde und im Jahr 1814 ihre Erstaufführung feierte.

programme.title: Mahler - Sinfonie Nr. 1 in D-Dur, 'Titan'
programme.desc: Das Maggio Musicale Fiorentino ist das älteste Opernfestival Italiens. Der Maestro Daniel Harding übernimmt das Dirigieren in einem wunderbaren Konzertprogramm mit der tragischen Ouvertüre in d-Moll, Op. 81 von Johannes Brahms.

programme.title: Neun Sinfonien verändern die Welt
programme.desc: Der Filmemacher Michael Waldmann besuchte das West-Eastern Divan Orchestra während der Proben in Spanien und schloss sich den Touren nach Südkorea und China an.

programme.title: Tschaikowski - 1. Klavierkonzert
programme.desc: Ein buntes Weihnachtskonzert der Philharmonie zuidnederland mit Tschaikowskis berühmtem Klavierkonzert Nr. 1. Chefdirigent Dmitri Liss bringt gemeinsam mit Meisterpianist Boris Berezovsky sein russisches Blut in Wallung.

programme.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 4 in B-Dur, op. 60
programme.desc: "Les Dissonances" spielen die 4. Sinfonie von Ludwig van Beethoven an der Opéra Dijon.

programme.title: Werke für Laute von J. S. Bach
programme.desc: Der französische Lautenist Thomas Dunford spielt in diesem intimen Kammermusikkonzert, das 2017 im Concertgebouw Brügge aufgezeichnet wurde, verschiedene Werke für Laute von J. S. Bach. Auf dem Programm steht Suite für Laute in g-Moll.

programme.title: In der Probe: - Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Mariss Jansons probt mit dem Oslo Philharmonischen Orchester die kraftvolle Suite aus Béla Bartóks Pantomimenballett "Der wunderbare Mandarin", gefolgt von einer Aufführung des gleichen Stücks aus dem Konzerthaus von Oslo.

programme.title: Donizetti - L'elisir d'amore
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza dirigiert das Orchester Gli Originali und den Coro Donizetti Opera. Diese Inszenierung von Frederic Wake-Walker aus dem Jahr 2021 ist einzigartig, da sie die vollständige, von Alberto Zedda rekonstruierte originale Partitur enthält.

programme.title: Mozart - 23. Klavierkonzerte, KV 488
programme.desc: Francesco Attesti gilt als einer der besten Interpreten des romantischen Repertoires. Zusammen mit dem Dirigenten Paolo Belloli und dem OIDA-Orchester spielt er die Klavierkonzerte Nr. 14 und 23, KV 449 und KV 488 von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert, Event) - 2020-12-03

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Finale: Schumann, Sibelius u. a
programme.desc: Der Bariton Arvid Fagerfjäll und der Pianist Hikaru Kanki führen "Lust der Sturmnacht" aus Robert Schumanns Kerner-Liedern, Op. 35 auf. Diese Aufführung wurde in der Verkadefabriek in 's-Hertogenbosch, Niederlande, aufgezeichnet. (Music, Classical) - 2023-09-05

programme.title: Brahms - Tragischen Ouvertüre in d-Moll, Op. 81
programme.desc: Maestro Daniel Harding dirigiert das Orchester des Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in einem Konzertprogramm mit der tragischen Ouvertüre in d-Moll, Op. 81 von Brahms und der Sinfonie Nr. 1 in D-Dur, 'Titan' von Mahler. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-06-13

programme.title: J. S. Bach - Messe in H-Moll (BWV 232)
programme.desc: Thomaskantor Georg Christoph Biller stand am Dirigentenpult, als das renommierte Freiburger Barockorchester und der Leipziger Thomanerchor Bachs Messe in h-Moll aufführte. Angeblich ist es das größte Musikwerk, das die Welt je gesehen hat, wie der Komponist und Dirigent Carl Friedrich Zelter 1811 euphorisch schrieb. Die h-Moll-Messe ist das letzte große Chorwerk Johann Sebastian Bachs und fraglos auch der Höhepunkt in seinem Gesamtwerk. (Special, Music, Event) - 2015-09-24
